notes:
Background: Mid-sized CCaaS vendor focusing on healthcare and fintech verticals. Primary goal: automated post-call briefs that create QA notes + coaching highlights and push summarized tickets into Zendesk/Salesforce. Current process: human QA writes summaries (2-3 min per call) -> expensive and slow. Wanted: 30–60s automated brief with highlights + redaction for PHI/PII.

Technical requirements and constraints (from call):
- Must support live streaming transcript ingestion from Twilio webhook and batch uploads from Genesys exports.
- POC SLA targets: sustain 500 concurrent active calls (simulated spikes to 800) while maintaining 95th pct brief generation < 900ms; average cost per brief must be < $0.08.
- Security: strict data residency for EU customers, SSO/SAML for agent console, HSM/KMS for key management, audit logs for transcript access.
- Retention: transcripts must be retained for 90 days by default, with easy purge API for regulated customers.
- Redaction: need automated redaction pipeline with human-review flagging for uncertain entities.
- Tool-calling: agent-assist should be able to trigger actions (create ticket, update case, open KB article) via outbound calls to CRM APIs — low-latency roundtrip required.

Quotes / call snippets: "If we can get reliable, redacted briefs within a minute, we'll reallocate 70% of QA time to coaching and MBR work." — Head of Support.
"Need to know how you handle spikes on Black Friday-style days — we can't have backlog." — VP Ops.

POC plan: 2-week POC. Week 1: integrate streaming + transcription pipeline, baseline brief generation on 50 concurrent calls. Week 2: load testing to 500 concurrent, then two stress runs to 800. Deliverables: latency/cost dashboard, sample redaction metrics, end-to-end demo with tool-calling into Salesforce.

Links / artifacts: security questionnaire (drive), POC pricing deck, Fireflies transcript from demo call, example transcript with redactions, proposed rollout plan for Dedicated clusters in EU region.

Notes/obs from SE: caching of common intro prefixes (greeting scripts) could reduce token usage significantly for transcripts; recommend trying Redwood Optimize suggestions on batching and KV caching in POC.

Stated blockers: still need formal SOC2 docs, legal signoff on data residency addendum, and ability to run a Private instance or Dedicated cluster for EU PHI customers.
